title: Unifying Policy Learning and State Prediction through Spatial Language Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.12172v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning how actions change scene geometry can provide complementary supervision for goal-directed manipulation. We introduce Spatial Language Modeling, which represents scene contours, goals, action targets, and future states with a shared vocabulary of discrete coordinates and semantic tokens. A task-specific grammar organizes these elements into spatial sequences, allowing one autoregressive Transformer to learn action generation and action-conditioned state prediction through a common next-token objective. We train the model from scratch using random-play transition pretraining followed by joint action and state training on expert demonstrations. During pretraining, recorded action coordinates condition subsequent state predictions and are excluded from the prediction loss. During control, the model decodes only executable action targets and updates its history with newly observed states. We evaluate the approach on Push-T in simul

translated_title: 通过空间语言建模统一策略学习与状态预测
translated_abstract: 学习动作如何改变场景几何结构，可以为面向目标的操作任务提供互补的监督信号。我们提出了空间语言建模，该方法使用由离散坐标和语义标记组成的共享词汇表来表示场景轮廓、目标、动作目标和未来状态。一种任务特定的语法将这些元素组织成空间序列，使得单个自回归Transformer能够通过统一的下一词预测目标，同时学习动作生成和动作条件下的状态预测。我们从零开始训练该模型：首先利用随机游玩产生的状态转移数据进行预训练，随后在专家演示数据上进行动作与状态的联合训练。在预训练过程中，记录的动作坐标用于条件化后续的状态预测，但不参与预测损失的计算。在控制阶段，模型仅解码可执行的动作目标，并根据新观测到的状态更新其历史信息。我们在模拟环境中的Push-T任务上对该方法进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出空间语言建模方法，用共享的离散坐标与语义标记词汇表统一表示场景轮廓、目标、动作和未来状态，使单个自回归Transformer通过统一的下一词预测目标同时学习动作生成与状态预测。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Spatial Language Modeling, which represents scene contours, goals, action targets, and future states with a shared vocabulary of discrete coordinates and semantic tokens, enabling a single autoregressive Transformer to jointly learn action generation and action-conditioned state prediction through a unified next-token objective.
